paginas.texto: The concert was on Friday and Oliver had written the best song of his life. On Wednesday he lost it.
'You should look in your bag,' said Ingrid. He looked. The bag had two apples and a sock.
'You could ask the music room,' said Maya. The music room said nothing, because rooms do not talk.
'Why don't you write it again?' asked Diego. 'Because I cannot remember it,' said Oliver. That was the whole problem.
They searched the library, the track, the garden and the kitchen. They found a hat, a ring and somebody's homework.
On Thursday night Oliver sat on the steps and hummed, because that is what he does when he is sad.
Kili landed next to him and hummed too. Badly. Very badly. But the four notes were the right ones.
Oliver stood up so fast that he frightened the condor. 'That is my song! You have been listening all week!'
He wrote it down twice: one for the concert and one for the kitchen wall, where nothing ever gets lost.
On Friday the whole school sang it, and one condor sat on the roof and sang it worse than everybody.
